assumptions.vent_gas: Nitrogen; the FullFlow config identifies nitrogen as the pressurant.
assumptions.vent_process: Adiabatic ideal-gas blowdown to ambient through the valve CdA; no piping restriction, heat transfer, or two-phase flow. The starting vent state is the FullFlow end-of-main-burn state: liquid residual mass comes from propellant_residuals.csv profile_end_kg, and tank pressure/ullage temperature are sampled from the free-flight results at the reported burn time. Ullage volume is tank volume minus residual liquid volume; it is not the 10% loaded ullage fraction.
assumptions.drain_process: Incompressible LOX discharge to ambient at the listed fixed ullage gauge pressures; no flashing, piping restriction, or outlet back-pressure.
assumptions.fill_process: Incompressible LOX fill through the fixed LFS path, OQD, and OFD in series, to a tank held at the listed fixed ullage gauge pressure. LFS supply pressure is the 250 psig value reported by the LOX Fill GFSSP Sim; it is not derived from any OFD value. ground_fill_path_cda_mm2 is that page's 0.00429 in2 (2.7677 mm2) LFS Fill System CdA. The script holds these LFS inputs fixed and sweeps candidate OFD CdAs, reporting fill time for each; it does not solve to a target fill time or recommend a valve. OQD CdA is not documented in the retrieved Notion material, so oqd_cda_mm2 is temporarily a 50 mm2 3/8 in valve estimate (0.375 in bore, Cd about 0.70). chilldown_and_boiloff_delay_s is a separate configurable first-pass delay, not a valve restriction. Hydrostatic pressure of the rising liquid column is included. No other hose, QD, line, vent, heat-leak, flashing, or back-pressure restrictions are included.
assumptions.fill_boiloff_pressure_control: The OVNT fill-pressure screen adds both displaced ullage gas and GOX generated by LOX boiloff. Boiloff is heat_load_W / latent_heat_J_kg. It checks candidate OVNT CdAs at a configurable tank control pressure, using ideal-gas oxygen properties. The heat-load sweep, LOX latent heat, GOX temperature, control pressure, and OVNT CdA sweep are provisional screening inputs until Hopper thermal and fill test data are available.
assumptions.fill_delay_reference: The configurable 2661.3 s delay is a provisional first-pass estimate based on an Elytra 48 min 90% fill reference. It is not a Hopper fill-time requirement. Change it when Hopper chilldown, boiloff, and conditioning data are available.
assumptions.tank_inside_diameter_in: FullFlow notes 8.5 in OD. This isolated drain model uses 8.5 in as an unverified effective ID.
